question: How is the corner width to be determined according to the accepted measure?
premises: The corner width is under consideration.
One part or a desired portion may be used.
This is stated as the accepted view.
inference: O twice-born ones, the corner width is considered to be determined by one part or by a desired portion.
uncertainties: The compound karṇa-vistāra-iṣṭāśena allows more than one syntactic reading.
plain_english: O twice-born ones, the corner width is considered to be set by one part or by a desired portion.
